notes.title: Next Major Update lands July 10: Save & Place Multiple Avatars!!
notes.notes:
Hey gogh players—and everyone who picked us up (or is about to) in the Summer Sale!


Our biggest update yet lands on Thu ✦ July 10—right before the Summer Sale ends!!


Here’s what’s coming…

 
1) Save Multiple Avatars!


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45297920/c52d43ccb65fc99eb5fbeb5395880302edbadd2b.png"]

No more picking just one—store up to nine avatar presets!!

Swap them on the fly or give every one of your nine rooms its own star performer.

 
2) Place Multiple Avatars!

Yep—drop up to nine avatars in a single room!!
Keep your main avatar grinding while side avatars chill, cheer, or just hang out, turning your workspace into something totally fresh. 

Screenshots are about to level up—get ready for a brand-new way to play and share.

We’ll dive into the finer details as launch gets closer.


3) Daily Routine Tracker!


If dev timing lines up, the new “Daily Routine” feature ships in the same patch!

Separate from your task-focused To-Do list, you’ll log repeatable habits—“Drink 1L of water,” “Meditate 5 min,” and so on—and tick them off each day.

 
4) Roughly 100 New Items!


And, of course, a haul of fresh content:

New room preset: “Brooklyn Style” (Normal size)

≈ 20 new avatar items (planned)

≈ 80 new room items (planned)

New Future Bass playlist “UMINEKO - Pixel Dreams”

notes.title: Update 1.1.0: Mac Support, New Productivity Tools, and Visual Refresh!
notes.notes:
1.1.0 Update Details!!

Thank you for waiting, Mac users!
You can now play gogh on Macs with Apple Silicon!
We hope you’ll make gogh your new productivity companion on Mac as well.

*1 The drag-and-drop image attachment feature for room items is not supported on Mac.

*2 Please note that some future features may not be compatible with Mac. We appreciate your understanding.


Focus tools, now even better!
We’ve added the following features to help you manage tasks and track your activity. More improvements are coming, so please try them out and share your feedback!

“Focus Stats” to record daily app runtime and timer usage

“Set Deadline” feature for the To-Do list

“Label Colors” for categorizing To-Do tasks

“Clear Completed Tasks” function to batch delete finished items


Visuals Refreshed!
With this update, we’ve refreshed the key visuals and app icon.
You’ll notice a new look on the store and in your library.



We’ve also fixed some bugs related to lighting items.

notes.title: Important Notice - Hotfix 1.0.2
notes.notes:
Adding the “Saturation Slider” and Its Impact on Saved Data

To reduce muddiness between original and new colors and to expand creative control, we’ve added a “Saturation Slider” to item recoloring.

Because of this change, some items in rooms or avatars you’ve already created may now appear brighter than before.

We apologize for the inconvenience and ask that you readjust any affected colors.
Thank you for your patience.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45297920/ba3c906a7a35c21bae63c1a441e74c207d04c2bd.jpg

If the game feels heavy, lower the frame rate to 60 fps or below in Graphics Settings, or reduce the resolution scale to improve performance.

notes.title: Demo Update!
notes.notes:
Since the demo was released on February 21, we’ve updated it three times based on everyone’s feedback!

Here are the main fixes:

 Fixed an issue where the game wouldn’t start in certain countries or regions
 Corrected the Traditional Chinese font
 Made it possible to rotate the avatar by dragging the mouse during avatar editing
 Prevented Kuroda42 from growing on its own while the timer is running
 Now only accepts mouse wheel input when hovering over the app window
 Widget positions are reset upon redisplay (temporary fix)
 Added a feature to hide certain UI elements based on the window’s aspect ratio
 Added some new room items
 Fixed a bug where the room item list could become empty
 Updated the count-up timer to support three-digit display
 And more…


If you played right after release and ran into issues, please give it another try!
